mechanism: Sample a BatchSize of states; for each, encode state, generate Actor actions, score with twin Critics; store Critic-improvement vs buffer reward and L2 action distance to buffer actions; keep only states whose action deviation ≤ 0.68-quantile of the batch (≈1σ of absolute deviations), then pick ArgMax of |reward_delta|/distance as the closed-form policy-update point.
data_needed: Offline State-Action-Reward trajectories; twin Critics; StateEncoder (price+indicators+account+timestamp harmonics); Actor continuous actions; BatchSize.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train Jan–Jul 2023, test Aug 2023; RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD defaults; ~500 trajectories × 3591 states
why_new_for_mis: Action–buffer distance gated by empirical quantile is a live Critic-reliability / distribution-shift sensor—MIS can refuse value-based decisions when current policy leaves the trusted action neighborhood.
quote: Regarding the reliability of the action evaluation, we have already said that the assessment of actions from the Critic is more accurate when the deviations from the training dataset distribution are minimal.

mechanism: Model the offline behavior policy as a mixture of Gaussians; derive closed-form improvement operators via LogSumExp lower bound and Jensen inequality, then pick the higher-ranked of µlse and µjensen under confidence τ—captures multimodal expert behaviors in heterogeneous datasets.
data_needed: Offline action distribution; Critic Q; mixture weights λi; confidence τ.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 CFPI stack; multimodal historical policies assumed
why_new_for_mis: Mixture-Gaussian modes of historical actions are discrete behavior/regime clusters—MIS can treat active mixture component as a soft trading-style regime label.
quote: Modeling the behavior policy as a mixture of Gaussian distributions provides better expressiveness but entails additional optimization difficulties.

mechanism: Two-stage GCPC: TrajNet Encoder (batch-norm→DropOut mask→conv→GPT attention, recurrent slot tokens) compresses price+indicator history into SoftMax-normalized EmbeddingSize vector B; Decoder reconstructs past bars and predicts PrecoderBars ahead of Close−Open, High−Open, Low−Open only (not indicators); PolicyNet MLP then acts from B+account+goal.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr (OHLC diffs + indicators); no account/actions in TrajNet; PrecoderBars future OHLC targets; DropOut p=0.8.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train first 7 months 2023, test Aug 2023; Real-ORL + random passes
why_new_for_mis: Goal-conditioned compressed trajectory embedding that jointly encodes past and predicted future OHLC is a neural foresight sensor—MIS can read B (and reconstruction/prediction error) as regime/path context without a separate forecast model.
quote: The strong empirical performance of GCPC comes from the latent representation of past and predicted states. In this case, state prediction is performed with a focus on set goals.

mechanism: From cumulative rewards in the buffer, recover per-step rewards then reverse-sum with DiscFactor over PrecoderBars; take ArgMax row as Actor goal (max achievable discounted reward within forecast horizon); Goal model (FQF) learns 2×-amplified positive / ½-damped negative targets from trajectory embedding alone.
data_needed: Cumulative reward vectors; DiscFactor; PrecoderBars; FQF goal head; Encoder embedding without account.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 GCPC; same train/test windows
why_new_for_mis: Horizon-max discounted reward as a state-conditioned goal is a change/opportunity sensor—MIS can track attainable reward peaks over a short forecast window as entry-urgency context.
quote: Therefore, our potential goal should be the maximum value over the forecast period, taking into account the discount factor.

mechanism: On clean trajectories, Noise head targets zeros; on noise-augmented trajectories, targets the reparameterized noise (mean_delta + ω·std_delta·N(0,1) from inter-bar parameter deltas). Joint loss = trajectory MSE + λ·noise MSE; Encoder features must support both spatial-consistent forecasts and noise identification.
data_needed: Clean and noise-augmented state sequences; per-feature delta mean/std; STD_Delta_Multiplier ω; STE_Noise_Multiplier λ; Encoder/Decoder/Noise nets.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; SSWNP integrated into GCPC TrajNet; train Jan–Jul 2023, test Aug 2023
why_new_for_mis: Explicit noise-prediction residual is a per-feature stochasticity/volatility sensor—MIS can treat high predicted noise as elevated local uncertainty of the bar state.
quote: The noise prediction module solves the auxiliary problem of identifying noise in the analyzed trajectories. This helps the movement prediction model better model potential spatial diversity.

mechanism: While training on clean batches, record row-wise differences between successive states into delta matrix; use column mean/std (scaled by ω) to reparameterize additive noise so augmentation stays inside natural change distributions rather than raw feature ranges.
data_needed: Sequential HistoryBars×BarDescr states; delta matrix (batch−1)×features; ω hyperparameter.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 trajectory autoencoder; significant deltas noted as market-situation changes
why_new_for_mis: Empirical inter-bar delta distribution is a change/jump sensor family—MIS can monitor realized vs expected delta norms as regime-shift intensity.
quote: A significant change in parameter values often indicates a change in the market situation.

mechanism: AutoBot Encoder: embed last bar → stack GPTBars → PE → MH attention over time → transpose → MH attention over features (social) → repeat Lenc; Decoder concatenates context with trainable Q modes, repeats temporal+feature attention Ldec, outputs PrecoderBars×3 OHLC deviations; train with STE-thresholded max-deviation backprop and SSWNP-style noise batches.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr; EmbeddingSize stack; PE harmonics; Ones vector for Q; PrecoderBars targets.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 7 months 2023; Alternate.mq5 forecast-quality test through end-2023
why_new_for_mis: Alternating temporal and cross-feature attention with discrete latent Q modes yields multimodal path forecasts—MIS can use mode-separated OHLC futures as a neural scenario sensor.
quote: AutoBots can predict the trajectory of one ego-agent or the distribution of future trajectories for all agents in the scene.

mechanism: ADAPT-style Encoder loops Lenc blocks of transpose+cross-attention (MH2Attention: Query from one tensor dim, Key/Value from the other) and self-attention to model agent↔time (feature↔bar) relations; MLP predicts NForecast endpoint triples (Close/High/Low extrema) with SoftMax scene probabilities; Actor consumes state+endpoint embeddings; endpoint gradients stopped when training Actor.
data_needed: BarDescr features as agents over HistoryBars; NForecast; SoftMax probs; account+endpoint encoders for Actor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train Jan–Jul 2023, test Aug 2023; indicators default
why_new_for_mis: Cross-dimensional attention between features and time plus multimodal extrema endpoints is a neural control-point sensor—MIS can sense upcoming High/Low/Close extremes and their mode probabilities.
quote: What's more important to us is the extremes of the maximum possible profits and drawdowns within the framework of this movement.

mechanism: Shape trajectory-endpoint targets with a priori indicators: MACD main vs signal (state[7], state[8]) sets bullish/bearish direct and truncates the cumulated OHLC path to the first extremum in that direction; Actor action targets further gated by RSI/CCI (state[4], state[5]) thresholds before allowing long/short TP/SL/lot.
data_needed: MACD main/signal, RSI, CCI in BarDescr; PrecoderBars future OHLC; NForecast multimodal heads.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 7 months 2023; OOS extended to 3 months; PF≈1.4 but only 11 trades
why_new_for_mis: Indicator-conditioned truncation of future extrema converts classical MACD/RSI/CCI into a supervised regime prior for neural endpoints—MIS can fuse rule priors with learned multimodal forecasts.
quote: If the signal line is above the main line, then we consider the current trend to be bullish. Otherwise, bearish.

mechanism: Encode agents via relative displacements Δ over Th; LSTM temporal encoder per agent; build fully-connected interaction graph with Crystal-GCN (edge = distance vector at tobs) then 4-head MHSA to form social attention matrix SATT—lightweight social context without full map rasters.
data_needed: Relative displacement series per feature/agent; Crystal-GCN weights; MHSA; optional map centerline priors.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 BaseLines.bd reuse; Crystal-GCN+MHSA encoder in trajectory net
why_new_for_mis: Graph convolution over relative feature displacements yields a compact interaction embedding—MIS can treat SATT rows as cross-feature coupling sensors for regime structure.
quote: Each row of the final social attention matrix SATT … represents an interaction feature for the agent i with surrounding agents, taking into account time information under the hood.

mechanism: Multi-future Transformer parallel interaction module: NForecast independent blocks each run MHSA (agent–agent) + MHCA (agent–context) with separate parameters so forward/backward signals never mix across modes; SoftMax scene-score head ranks modes; winner-take-all loss at scene level.
data_needed: Encoder context tensor; NForecast parallel CNeuronMFTOCL paths; SoftMax scene probs; endpoint decoder.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train Jan–Jul 2023, test Aug 2023; 13 trades, PF 1.63
why_new_for_mis: Isolated unimodal futures with scene probabilities are an explicit multi-regime forecast bank—MIS can track top-mode identity and entropy of SoftMax scores as regime-uncertainty.
quote: the main difference between each target distribution mode lies in the different interaction models between agents, and between agents and context.

mechanism: XCA attends over feature channels via cross-covariance of L2-normalized Q/K (size d×d) with temperature τ, split into h heads—complexity O(N d²/h) linear in tokens; followed by LPI (two convs + batch-norm GELU) and FFN; stacked as CNeuronXCiTOCL inside trajectory Encoder with MFT.
data_needed: Token sequence length N, feature dim d, heads h; PE; LPI window; batch norm stats.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; XCiT.bd from MFT; ~2% faster train; Aug 2023 OOS with higher PF
why_new_for_mis: Channel-wise cross-covariance attention is a scalable neural sensor for long bar histories—MIS can embed long windows without quadratic token attention cost.
quote: The proposed cross-covariance attention overcomes this drawback because its computational complexity O(Nd^2/h) scales linearly with the number of tokens.

mechanism: Skip intermediate price-trajectory prediction; DOT backbone (local SW-MSA + channel global attention + SAA semantic exchange across stages) extracts multi-scale features; Scale-Aggregated Encoder collapses to one map; Task-Aligned Encoder yields cls/reg features; Actor+Critic act/value directly from DOT embedding+account—reduces forecast-error cascade into actions.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr (OHLC diffs, tick_volume/1000, RSI, CCI, ATR, MACD main/signal); GPTBars stack; Actor continuous actions; Critic rewards.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 500 random trajectories Jan–Jul 2023; test Aug 2023; light compute
why_new_for_mis: Decoder-free dense sensing that maps multi-scale history features straight to policy avoids forecast-error amplification—MIS can use DOT embeddings as action-ready state sensors.
quote: What if we eliminate the intermediate stage of predicting the trajectory of the upcoming price movement. Let's return to the classic reinforcement learning approach.

mechanism: FAQ: maintain base Queries; generate dynamic Queries from neighboring-frame features via grouped weighted averages with weights V from global-pooled frame features; aggregate neighbor Queries with cosine-similarity weights w_i(F, F_i); Decoder uses dynamic Queries at inference—temporal object/state detection over bar sequences.
data_needed: Encoder features F, F_i from adjacent bars/frames; base Query groups; global pool A; mapping G; cosine aggregation weights.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train Jan–Jul 2023, test Aug 2023; 87 trades, 51.72% wins, PF 1.61, RF 1.65
why_new_for_mis: Feature-similarity-weighted aggregation of temporal Queries is a motion/change object sensor for bar video—MIS can detect evolving patterns across neighboring bars better than static single-frame attention.
quote: Object detection in video has a number of certain characteristics and must solve the problem of changes in object features caused by motion, which are not encountered in the image domain.

mechanism: GTE Encoder: multi-head Connected Node Attention (CNA) over graph-linked nodes and Non-connected Node Attention (NNA) over dis-adjacent nodes, each with learnable scales α/β; then Crystal-style graph convolution for local structure; optional mask-and-reconstruct pretrain (≤40% nodes/edges) so embeddings learn local and global graph context before Actor/Critic finetune.
data_needed: Graph of features/agents with adjacency; noise+type node init optional; mask ratio; Actor/Critic heads.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; two-stage StudyEncoder then Study; Aug 2023 test averaged toward buffer mean policy
why_new_for_mis: Separate attention over linked vs unlinked feature nodes senses which market factors co-move vs compete—MIS adjacency-aware coupling sensor.
quote: GTE combines Self-Attention of the Transformer and Graph Convolution models to capture global and local correlations, respectively.

mechanism: CCMR Encoder: FeatureExtractor embeds current state; Motion = Feature_t − Feature_{t−1}; LocalContext encoder → XCiT GlobalContext; Cross-XCiT guides motion features by global context (CMF); LSTM recurrent unit updates flow; Upscale to EmbeddingSize—explicit optical-flow-style dynamics sensor for bar sequences.
data_needed: Sequential bar states; PrevFeatures buffer; CCCMREncoder×2; XCiT; CrossXCiT; LSTM; residual conv feature pyramid.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train Jan–Jul 2023, test Aug 2023; 21 trades, 52.3% wins, PF 1.22
why_new_for_mis: Context-guided motion from consecutive feature deltas is an explicit change/flow sensor—MIS can read Motion/CMF norms as short-horizon regime-shift intensity beyond static bar snapshots.
quote: we have never assessed the dynamics of environmental indicators. … However, in the field of computer vision, there is a fundamental problem of optical flow estimation.
